1. Etage anlegen und Wände zeichnen (ode:
1. Create a floor and draw walls (or upload a floor plan and trace it).
2. Name the rooms with Define room – every room becomes a storage area.
3. Place cabinets, shelves and kitchen furniture from the catalogue – their compartments become locations (letter on the furniture = column).
4. Switch on Storage in 3D: click a compartment, check in, take out. "Where is …?" at the top searches the whole house.
